idea: Post-close 0.99/0.999 wall camping

idea: Hairline-underdog inverse
mechanism: Bet the underdog when our arithmetic calls the window a coin flip, on the theory the book overprices favorites in hairline windows
evidence: N=14,897 windows; label-space richness (+9.2c/sh) inverts to -2.2c/sh when conditioned on the only tradable trigger (small displacement at fire time); negative in every displacement band
reopening_condition: not restated; superseded by the standing monotonicity bar this finding helped establish

idea: Open head-start / cross-window strike knowledge (N's final = N+1's strike, trade N+1's open)
mechanism: Buy the favored side of window N+1 at open using the known incoming strike (=N's final) vs N+1's opening spot
evidence: 30s era: N=749 windows (08-10), decision rule anti-predictive, best cell = 'model says don't buy', Gamma never serves the strike first (0/757). 60s era (H2, 08-21): N=1,972 windows, chain invariant verified 1,956/1,956; held-out EW -2.13..-4.43c/sh at every delta in [2,30]s vs +5c/sh bar; monotonicity fails at all 5 deltas; anti-side also negative 4/5 deltas; pre-open leak unmeasurable (1/1,972 windows has pre-open BBO)

reopening_condition: subscribe N+1's tokens >=60s pre-open in the micro-tape recorder AND find evidence the CLOB matches orders pre-open at all (none found); re-measure at >=14 days

idea: Continuous P(win) body trading
mechanism: Trade a calibrated continuous win-probability model against the book mid throughout the window body, not just the tail lock
evidence: Calibration excellent OOS yet the book beats the model on log score in 100% of splits (30s era, 08-10). Re-affirmed 09-01 on 60s-era data with new external features (info_program): book beats logit+GBT models at all 5 horizons k in {30,180}s..{240}s with one-sided bootstrap mass over 19 days / 17,269 rows; addendum shows the book is perfectly calibrated (M0) and 0/135 feature x horizon tests reach even nominal p<0.05 (M1)

reopening_condition: a genuinely new DATA CLASS (private/paid order flow, cross-venue L2 at depth) -- not new models on the same inputs

idea: Latency race / oracle-lag head start (be the fast participant on Chainlink lag or raw Binance ticks)
